facts.fact: Burundi's National Assembly unanimously adopted a bill governing the collection and processing of personal data across public and private sectors on 15 January 2026; the document does not report promulgation.
The adopted law creates an independent administrative data-protection authority responsible for enforcement; the document does not say it has been constituted.
